# Redwood Montessori School

> Where independence is key — a home-style Montessori school for children from 13 months to 12 years.

Website: https://redwoodmontessori.in/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 95001 24257

## Key facts
- 1,000 children and more have walked our halls
- 13 months: the age toddlers can join
- 3 languages: Tamil, Hindi and English

## Facilities
- Toddler Community (13 months+)
- Primary (2½ to 6 years)
- Elementary (6 to 12 years)
- Practical life exercises
- Sensorial materials
- Organic meals cooked in school
- A nurse on each campus
- Book clubs
- Football tournament
- Gardening & composting
- Art & block printing
- No devices before age 7

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Redwood Montessori School?
10/19 Arundale Beach Road, 1st Street, Besant Nagar, Chennai 600 090.

### What facilities does Redwood Montessori School have?
Toddler Community (13 months+), Primary (2½ to 6 years), Elementary (6 to 12 years), Practical life exercises, Sensorial materials, Organic meals cooked in school, A nurse on each campus, Book clubs, Football tournament, Gardening & composting, Art & block printing, No devices before age 7.

### At what age can my child join?
Children can join the Toddler Community from 13 months, or from the time they start walking independently. Primary is from 2½ years, Elementary from 6 years.

### What do the children eat?
Four meals — breakfast, snack, lunch and late snack — cooked fresh in school with locally sourced, organic ingredients and no sugar — only palm and coconut sugar.

### How do I apply to Redwood Montessori School?
Pick a date on this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call our admissions team on +91 95001 24257.
